mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE nickname = #{nickname})

SELECT user_id, nickname, profile_image_url, profile_image_storage_key FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND nickname LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(nickname), nickname LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( login_id, email, password_hash, phone_number, nickname, profile_image_url, profile_image_storage_key, profile_image_content_type, profile_image_file_size, bio, role, status, email_verified_at, phone_verified_at, last_login_at, login_fail_count, locked_until, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{phoneNumber}, #{nickname}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{profileImageStorageKey}, #{profileImageContentType}, #{profileImageFileSize}, #{bio}, #{role}, #{status}, #{emailVerifiedAt}, #{phoneVerifiedAt}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{loginFailCount}, #{lockedUntil}, #{passwordChangedAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
